sentences.zh: 及賈庶人死，乃誅劉振、孫慮、程據等，冊復太子曰：「皇帝使使持節、兼司空、衛尉伊策故皇太子之靈曰：嗚呼！

translations.literal: When Deposed Commoner Jia died, they executed Liu Zhen, Sun Lü, Cheng Ju, and others, and posthumously restored the crown prince; the edict read: 'The emperor dispatches the credential-bearer, concurrent Director of Works, Commandant of the Guard Yi to announce by patent to the spirit of the late crown prince: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: When Deposed Commoner Jia died, they executed Liu Zhen, Sun Lü, Cheng Ju, and others, and posthumously restored the crown prince; the edict read: "The emperor dispatches the credential-bearer, concurrent Director of Works, Commandant of the Guard Yi to announce by patent to the spirit of the late crown prince: Alas!

sentences.zh: 維爾少資岐嶷之質，荷先帝殊異之寵，大啟土宇，奄有淮陵。

translations.literal: In youth you were endowed with precocious wisdom and enjoyed the late emperor’s exceptional affection. He granted you a great domain and possession of Huailing.
translations.idiomatic: In youth you were endowed with precocious wisdom and enjoyed the late emperor’s exceptional affection. He granted you a great domain and possession of Huailing.

sentences.zh: 朕奉遵遺旨，越建爾儲副，以光顯我祖宗。

translations.literal: I followed his last wishes and established you as heir, to glorify our ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: I followed his last wishes and established you as heir, to glorify our ancestors.

sentences.zh: 祗爾德行，以從保傅，事親孝敬，禮無違者。

translations.literal: I charged you to follow tutors in virtue, serving parents with filial respect—ritual unbreached.
translations.idiomatic: You were to revere virtuous conduct and follow your tutors, serve your parents with filial respect, and never violate ritual.

sentences.zh: 而朕昧於凶構，致爾於非命之禍，俾申生、孝己復見於今。

translations.literal: Yet I, dim to vicious plots, brought you to the misfortune of untimely death, making Shen Sheng and Xiao Ji again appear in our day.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I failed to perceive wicked intrigues and brought you to an unnatural death, so that Shen Sheng and Xiao Ji appeared again in our time.

sentences.zh: 賴宰相賢明，人神憤怨，用啟朕心，討厥有罪，咸伏其辜。

translations.literal: Thanks to wise ministers, human and spirit alike resented, opening my heart to punish the guilty—each has met sentence.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunately, wise ministers and the indignation of men and spirits opened my eyes; I punished the guilty, and all paid the penalty for their crimes.

sentences.zh: 何補於荼毒冤魂酷痛哉？

translations.literal: What use mending poisoned wronged souls' cruel pain?
translations.idiomatic: But how can that make amends for the cruel suffering inflicted upon your wronged spirit?

sentences.zh: 是用忉怛悼恨，震動於五內。

translations.literal: Therefore grief tears my vitals and shakes my five inner organs.
translations.idiomatic: Thus I grieve in anguish and regret, shaken to my innermost being.

sentences.zh: 今追復皇太子喪禮，反葬京畿，祠乙太牢。

translations.literal: Now I restore the funeral rites due the crown prince, return your burial to the capital region, and offer a full tailao sacrifice of ox, sheep, and pig.
translations.idiomatic: Now I restore the funeral rites due the crown prince, return your burial to the capital region, and offer a full tailao sacrifice of ox, sheep, and pig.

translations.literal: If soul possesses awareness may it receive this heart.'
translations.idiomatic: If soul possesses awareness may it receive this heart."

sentences.zh: 帝為太子服長子斬衰，群臣齊衰，使尚書和郁率東宮官屬具吉凶之制，迎太子喪于許昌。

translations.literal: The emperor wore unhemmed mourning for the crown prince as for an eldest son; the ministers wore hemmed mourning. He sent Minister He Yu to lead the Eastern Palace officials in preparing the prescribed auspicious and mourning rites and bringing the crown prince's bier back from Xuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Court mourned and fetched Yu's bier from Xu.
